ABOUT / MANUFACTURER CAPABILITIES

Behind the equipment.

Boya Gongdao runs engineering, survey and port operations in China. These capabilities support the products on this site; their availability for overseas projects is confirmed case by case.

ENGINEERING TEAM

Offshore and underwater services.

The manufacturer’s engineering team operates its ROVs and AUVs on survey, inspection, installation and emergency work in Chinese waters.

01

Structure inspection & integrity

Corrosion surveys, crack and defect detection, cathodic-protection measurements, marine-growth surveys and assessment reports.

02

Installation & construction support

Subsea pipeline and cable laying and maintenance, structure installation, bolting, grouting and levelling.

03

Integration, training & support

Custom system integration, operator training, long-term maintenance and remote technical support.

04

Survey & sampling

Geological sampling, ecological assessment, long-term hydro-meteorological observation, target search and pollution tracing.

05

3D data & analysis

Multibeam, laser scanning and HD video point clouds, with deformation analysis and digital asset models.

06

Emergency response

Leak location and temporary sealing, search and recovery of sunken objects, emergency reinforcement and incident surveys.

RESEARCH PORT

Nanshan research port, Sanya.

The manufacturer operates a public research wharf at Nanshan port in Sanya, about 164 km from waters 1,000 m deep, so deep-water trial sites can be reached in about half a day. It reports 2,152 research and trial voyages supported in 2025, with berthing, equipment testing, supply, data and crew services.

SURVEY VESSEL

A 41 m research vessel.

The fleet includes a 41 m survey vessel classed by China Classification Society, with dynamic positioning, a heavy A-frame for ROV and instrument deployment, multibeam bathymetry and a sub-bottom profiler.

Vessel particulars

  • Length 41 m, beam 9.2 m, draught 2.5 m
  • Maximum speed 11 kn
  • Displacement 655.3 t
  • Range 2,000 nmi; endurance 15 days
  • 8 crew and 13 technical staff

EXAMPLE WORKFLOW

Seabed sampling with an R-150.

For a 2025 seabed mineral survey off Hainan, the manufacturer describes this sequence: the research vessel reaches the target area and surveys it, an R-150 is deployed to the seabed, HD video guides the selection of sampling points, the ROV takes vertical samples, and samples are sealed and labelled for analysis.

Review the R-150
These services are performed by the manufacturer, mainly in Chinese waters. They are not services delivered by PanPan Marine. Whether any of them can support an overseas project is confirmed case by case.
